WebRTC RFC 8872 / RFC 8858 Multi-Stream SSRC Isolation & rtcp-mux-only PT [96,127] Collision Gate

❌ Legacy Multi-Stream RTP/RTCP Multiplexing Failures (RFC 8872/8858)
1. Cross-Track SSRC Misrouting: Video or RTX stream reuses audio SSRC across
bundled a=mid sections -> video packets fed into Opus decoder (loud static).
2. M=1 Talkspurt PT 64-95 Collision: When Marker=1, PT 64..95 yields Byte2
192..223, colliding with RTCP SR(200)/RR(201) and clipping first syllables.
3. Dual-Component ICE Bloat: Omitting a=rtcp-mux-only forces component=2
RTP+1 STUN/TURN allocations, doubling candidate checks and port usage.
Result: First-syllable talkspurt drops + cross-track audio static
✅ Deterministic P985–P986 🎉 Multi-Stream SSRC & rtcp-mux-only Gate
1. P985 (994th Guard) Per-mid SSRC Ownership Lock: Bind each SSRC to a
single a=mid until RTCP BYE & clamp active SSRCs per mid within [1, 8].
2. P986 🎉 (🎉 995th Guard & SVG 140) Exclusive mux-only & Safe Dynamic PT:
Require a=rtcp-mux-only & clamp dynamic RTP PT strictly in [96, 127].
3. Zero Talkspurt Clipping: M=1 with PT 96..127 maps to Byte2 224..255,
100% disjoint from RTCP packet types 192..223 on shared UDP ports.
Result: 0 cross-track SSRC misroutes · 0 RTCP demux collisions · PT ∈ [96,127]
Deterministic Enforcement Matrix & Historic SVG 140 / 995-Guard Milestone (Stage 496 · 938 Tests)
• P985-WEBRTC-RFC8872-MULTI-STREAM-SSRC-SESSION-MULTIPLEXING-AND-CROSS-TRACK-LOOP-GATE [994th Guardrail]:
uniqueSsrcPerMidBinding && crossTrackSsrcMisroutedPackets == 0 && maxActiveSsrcsPerMid ∈ [1, 8]
• P986-WEBRTC-RFC8858-RTCP-MUX-ONLY-EXCLUSIVE-MULTIPLEXING-AND-PT-COLLISION-GATE [🎉 995th Guard & SVG 140 / 1,004th Probe]:
rtcpMuxOnlyNegotiated && rtpRtcpDemuxCollisions == 0 && dynamicRtpPayloadType ∈ [96, 127] (forbid [64, 95])
